name: a revoked share reads nothing new: the guest's old key and link fail, and files written after the revocation use a key the guest never had
description: MBOX-012 (OX App Suite behind mailbox.org Drive): guests kept access after the owner removed their permissions; other shares lost theirs. Rules M1 and S14 and the share design: revocation ends access, and new content in the folder is wrapped with a rotated key. sync-chaos share-links-and-revocation (pending: share keys in the upload transaction).
pending: drive_share {device, path, to, link} and drive_unshare {device, path, to} (the window's share and revoke), drive_open fields share and as_user (a participant's device on the shared folder), and the check share_reads {device, key, via: "key"|"link", ok} (whether the participant's old key or link still reads an object)
